title: fix(plugin-auth)!: with SSO domain verification on, an SSO sign-in links to an existing account, or changes its email address, only at a domain the provider has proven
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches SSO domain verification, account linking or an address change through an SSO provider; `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` ("Domain verification (opt-in)") states the rule.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:开启 SSO 域名验证后,"经由身份提供方到达的账号,其邮箱只能位于该提供方已验证的域名"这条规则(此前只管新建账号)现在也管另外两种情况:SSO 登录隐式关联到已有账号,以及后续 SSO 登录声明了与账号不同的邮箱地址。不满足即以 `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED` 拒绝,不写关联、不发会话、已存邮箱不变。
- 为什么改:让域名验证的保证在账号被"到达"的每一条路径上都成立,而不只是在新建时;规则、错误码与匹配方式(精确匹配,子域名须自身列出并验证)与新建时完全相同。
- 风险与回滚:仅在开启域名验证的环境生效;关闭验证、非 SSO 来源、用户自己的显式关联、声明账号原有邮箱的登录均不变。已有本地账号位于未列出子域名的人,首次经 SSO 登录会被拒,需把该域名加到提供方并重新验证。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/implicit-account-linking.ts`(规则 4:`refuseImplicitAccountLink` 中新增的判定与 `refuseSsoAddressChangeOutsideProvenDomain`,读不到提供方即拒);`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-auth-instance.ts`(`validateUserInfo` 的串接顺序);`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-account-at-proven-domain.ts`(仅抽出 `readSsoProviderProvenDomains`,新建规则行为不变)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/implicit-account-linking.test.ts src/sso-oidc-refusal-cause.test.ts src/sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts src/sso-account-at-proven-domain.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 205 passed (205)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

With SSO domain verification on, an account reached through a provider holds an email address only at a domain that provider has proven. Account creation already follows this rule; this change applies the same rule, with the same module, to the two other ways an SSO sign-in (SAML or OIDC) reaches an account.

- **An implicit link.** An SSO sign-in that links to an account that already exists is refused unless the asserted address is at a domain the provider has proven, by equality: a subdomain counts only when it is itself listed and verified (`refuseImplicitAccountLink`, rule 4 in the `implicit-account-linking.ts` header).
- **An address change.** An SSO sign-in into an account the provider is already linked to, asserting an address other than the account's own, is refused unless the asserted address is at a proven domain (`refuseSsoAddressChangeOutsideProvenDomain`, new, chained into `validateUserInfo` after the link gate and before the audience gate). A sign-in that asserts the account's own address (compared ignoring case) is not re-judged.
- **The refusal** is `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED`, the code creation answers, with a rule-level description per case that names no domain. No new error code.
- **Fail closed.** A provider row that cannot be read refuses (one `warn` line); an account that cannot be read throws, which the sign-in answers as a refusal.
- **Reuse.** The provider read moves out of `refuseSsoAccountOutsideProvenDomain` into the exported `readSsoProviderProvenDomains` (no reader, no provider id or no row: none; a failed read: `null`). The creation rule's behaviour is unchanged and its tests are untouched.
- **Unchanged.** Verification off; non-SSO sources (the cloud identity provider and enterprise OAuth providers); an explicit link from account settings; the domain-matching rule itself.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` states the rule for a link and an address change, replacing the bullet that said existing accounts are never re-checked.

## Tests

Named by the rule.

- `sso-oidc-refusal-cause.test.ts`, section 6 (real `AuthManager`, real vendor callback, stubbed IdP): an implicit link at an unlisted subdomain is refused with no `sys_account` row and no session; an implicit link at a proven domain links and signs in; an address change to an outside address, and to an unlisted subdomain, is refused with the stored email unchanged and no new session; a change to another proven domain applies. CONTROLS: verification off (link made, change applied as today); a later sign-in with the stored address.
- `sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts`: the same link pair over SAML, plus the verification-off CONTROL.
- `implicit-account-linking.test.ts`, new top-level describe: the rule on its own inputs, OIDC and SAML; fail-closed cases; CONTROLS for verification off, a non-SSO source, an explicit link (an OAuth source), and the creation rule unchanged.
